reciprocal.into: P096 — Let the many become one — and be increased by one
reciprocal.why: P096 presents Whitehead's formula of many becoming one; P153 borrows his descriptions of becoming to reflect on one's contribution to an unfolding situation.

reciprocal.into: A060 — Forgive but do not excuse
reciprocal.why: A060 separates forgiving from excusing; P166 supplies Rogers's account of acceptance that is not approval, the same distinction drawn for the therapy relationship.

reciprocal.into: S066 — Be gentle with yourself in the review
reciprocal.why: S066 counsels gentleness toward yourself when reviewing your work; P166 carries Rogers's account of non-contingent regard, a comparable practice for the self and for others.
D127 holds that a person's worth is not forfeited; P166 carries the practical correlate, offering regard without conditions attached.
